AGT-1.reason: Scope choice, not a demonstrated hardware impossibility. Imported base/registry fixtures are narrower than full host/provider execution.
AGT-1.resume_requires: Select an integrated old/new host installation, provider (local or service), session/clone/persistence protocol and supported model/configuration; record full installation/import/retry results.

AGT-2.reason: Scope choice, not a GPU prerequisite. The tiny pilot completed but strict scoring/formatting failures and two profiles do not establish broad useful memory behavior.
AGT-2.resume_requires: Freeze a fresh larger/adverse matched cohort, model/retriever/budgets and appropriate predeclared quality adjudication; retain all writes/reads, failures and uncertainty. Do not overwrite old zeros.

TRN-2.reason: The executed evidence is a local CPU probability contract. It does not run the pinned upstream multi-worker backend/queue path.
TRN-2.resume_requires: Choose and qualify the actual rollout/learner/backend deployment and worker resources; log behavior/anchor/learner identities, queue/staleness, masks and stage timing under fixed workload.

CMP-2.reason: The current host/process is Darwin arm64 with no CUDA/HIP build/device; the observed vLLM wheels are Linux candidates. No separate qualified deployment is recorded.
CMP-2.resume_requires: Provide or choose an eligible Linux/target cohort and supported NIXL/backend/layout profile; install, import and run failure/cancel/ownership and cold/shared-prefix comparisons.

CMP-3.reason: The selected FA4 SM100/CUDA kernel and TileLang target contracts have no eligible local CUDA/ROCm execution evidence. Source/scalar checks cannot supply it.
CMP-3.resume_requires: Use supported owned target(s), pinned compiler/runtime/builds and actual dispatch; predeclare independent numerical tolerances/tails/safety and equal-work timing before cross-backend comparison.

CMP-5.reason: The executed restart is real CPU DDP/DCP, not the pinned TorchTitan/FSDP2 target recipe. Local eligibility observations do not qualify that GPU deployment.
CMP-5.resume_requires: Choose the target/process topology and checkpoint/storage/failure contract; execute actual recipe uninterrupted/resumed state/data/RNG/work/stall comparisons and declared worker-loss/durability controls.

optional_projects: The ten potential projects and broader learned-quality/physical/device/portability extensions are explicitly deferred from this bounded audit pass; they are not proven completed or novel.
